title: 1.3 Transformations of Linear and Absolute Value Functions

icans: I can write functions that represent translations and reflections.
I can write functions that represent stretches and shrinks.
I can write functions that represent combinations of transformations.

vocab: g(x) = ______________ when a > 1, a stretch when 0 < a < 1

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Inside or outside: Horizontal changes go inside: f(_______________). Vertical changes go outside: _______________.
Translations and reflections: Right h: f(________) Up k: _______________ Reflect in the y-axis: f(______)

blocks.stem: f(x) = 2x − 1. Write a rule for g, a translation 3 units up, and for h, a translation 2 units left.
f(x) = |x + 3| + 1. Write a rule for g, a reflection in the x-axis, and for h, a reflection in the y-axis.

a.  f(x) = x + 2. Write g, a horizontal shrink by a factor of ⅓.
b.  f(x) = |x| − 1. Write h, a vertical stretch by a factor of 4.
f(x) = 3x + 4. Write g, a translation 5 units right.

tickets.stem: f(x) = x − 5. Write g(x) = f(x) + 4 and simplify.
f(x) = |x|. Write g, a vertical shrink by a factor of ½.
